source_text: A by-way to my purpose.
target_text: A by-way to my purpose.

source_text: I am the leading-string of the ego, and the prompter of its notions.
target_text: I am the leading-string of the ego, and the prompter of its notions.

source_text: The Self saith unto the ego:
target_text: The Self saith unto the ego:

source_text: and for that very purpose it IS MEANT to think.
target_text: and for that very purpose it IS MEANT to think.

source_text: The Self saith unto the ego:
target_text: The Self saith unto the ego:

source_text: "Feel pleasure!"
target_text: "Feel pleasure!"

source_text: and for that very purpose it IS MEANT to think.
target_text: and for that very purpose it IS MEANT to think.

source_text: To the despisers of the body will I speak a word.
target_text: To the despisers of the body will I speak a word.

source_text: That they despise is caused by their esteem.
target_text: That they despise is caused by their esteem.

source_text: What is it that created esteeming and despising and worth and will?
target_text: What is it that created esteeming and despising and worth and will?

source_text: The creating Self created for itself esteeming and despising, it created for itself joy and woe.
target_text: The creating Self created for itself esteeming and despising, it created for itself joy and woe.

source_text: The creating body created for itself spirit, as a hand to its will.
target_text: The creating body created for itself spirit, as a hand to its will.

source_text: I tell you, your very Self wanteth to die, and turneth away from life.
target_text: I tell you, your very Self wanteth to die, and turneth away from life.

source_text: create beyond itself.
target_text: create beyond itself.

source_text: But it is now too late to do so: -
target_text: But it is now too late to do so: -

source_text: and therefore have ye become despisers of the body.
target_text: and therefore have ye become despisers of the body.

source_text: For ye can no longer create beyond yourselves.
target_text: For ye can no longer create beyond yourselves.

source_text: And therefore are ye now angry with life and with the earth.
target_text: And therefore are ye now angry with life and with the earth.

source_text: I go not your way, ye despisers of the body!
target_text: I go not your way, ye despisers of the body!

source_text: Ye are no bridges for me to the Superman!
target_text: Ye are no bridges for me to the Superman!

source_text: Thus spake Zarathustra.
target_text: Thus spake Zarathustra.

source_text: My brother, when thou hast a virtue, and it is thine own virtue, thou hast it in common with no one.
target_text: My brother, when thou hast a virtue, and it is thine own virtue, thou hast it in common with no one.

source_text: To be sure, thou wouldst call it by name and caress it;
target_text: To be sure, thou wouldst call it by name and caress it;

source_text: thou wouldst pull its ears and amuse thyself with it.
target_text: thou wouldst pull its ears and amuse thyself with it.

source_text: And lo!
target_text: And lo!

source_text: Then hast thou its name in common with the people, and hast become one of the people and the herd with thy virtue!
target_text: Then hast thou its name in common with the people, and hast become one of the people and the herd with thy virtue!

source_text: Better for thee to say:
target_text: Better for thee to say:

source_text: Thus speak and stammer:
target_text: Thus speak and stammer:

source_text: An earthly virtue is it which I love:
target_text: An earthly virtue is it which I love:

source_text: But that bird built its nest beside me:
target_text: But that bird built its nest beside me:

source_text: therefore, I love and cherish it -
target_text: therefore, I love and cherish it -

source_text: Thus shouldst thou stammer, and praise thy virtue.
target_text: Thus shouldst thou stammer, and praise thy virtue.

source_text: But now hast thou only thy virtues: they grew out of thy passions.
target_text: But now hast thou only thy virtues: they grew out of thy passions.

source_text: then became they thy virtues and joys.
target_text: then became they thy virtues and joys.

source_text: And though thou wert of the race of the hot-tempered, or of the voluptuous, or of the fanatical, or the vindictive;
target_text: And though thou wert of the race of the hot-tempered, or of the voluptuous, or of the fanatical, or the vindictive;

source_text: All thy passions in the end became virtues, and all thy devils angels.
target_text: All thy passions in the end became virtues, and all thy devils angels.

source_text: but they changed at last into birds and charming songstresses.
target_text: but they changed at last into birds and charming songstresses.

source_text: And nothing evil groweth in thee any longer, unless it be the evil that groweth out of the conflict of thy virtues.
target_text: And nothing evil groweth in thee any longer, unless it be the evil that groweth out of the conflict of thy virtues.

source_text: My brother, if thou be fortunate, then wilt thou have one virtue and no more:
target_text: My brother, if thou be fortunate, then wilt thou have one virtue and no more:

source_text: thus goest thou easier over the bridge.
target_text: thus goest thou easier over the bridge.

source_text: Illustrious is it to have many virtues, but a hard lot;
target_text: Illustrious is it to have many virtues, but a hard lot;

source_text: and many a one hath gone into the wilderness and killed himself, because he was weary of being the battle and battlefield of virtues.
target_text: and many a one hath gone into the wilderness and killed himself, because he was weary of being the battle and battlefield of virtues.

source_text: Necessary, however, is the evil;
target_text: Necessary, however, is the evil;

source_text: necessary are the envy and the distrust and the back-biting among the virtues.
target_text: necessary are the envy and the distrust and the back-biting among the virtues.

source_text: it wanteth thy whole spirit to be ITS herald, it wanteth thy whole power, in wrath, hatred, and love.

target_text: he seeketh to cause pain with that which causeth him pain.

target_text: And if your thoughts succumb, your uprightness shall still shout triumph thereby!

target_text: Ye shall love peace as a means to new wars -

source_text: You I advise not to work, but to fight.
target_text: You I advise not to work, but to fight.

source_text: You I advise not to peace, but to victory.
target_text: You I advise not to peace, but to victory.

source_text: Let your work be a fight, let your peace be a victory!
target_text: Let your work be a fight, let your peace be a victory!

source_text: Let your peace be a victory!
target_text: Let your peace be a victory!

source_text: Ye say it is the good cause which halloweth even war?
target_text: Ye say it is the good cause which halloweth even war?

source_text: War and courage have done more great things than charity.
target_text: War and courage have done more great things than charity.

source_text: Not your sympathy, but your bravery hath hitherto saved the victims.
target_text: Not your sympathy, but your bravery hath hitherto saved the victims.

source_text: "What is good?"
target_text: "What is good?"

source_text: To be brave is good.
target_text: To be brave is good.

source_text: To be good is what is pretty, and at the same time touching.
target_text: To be good is what is pretty, and at the same time touching.

source_text: They call you heartless:
target_text: They call you heartless:

source_text: Ye are ashamed of your flow, and others are ashamed of their ebb.
target_text: Ye are ashamed of your flow, and others are ashamed of their ebb.

source_text: Ye are ugly?
target_text: Ye are ugly?

source_text: Well then, my brethren, take the sublime about you, the mantle of the ugly!
target_text: Well then, my brethren, take the sublime about you, the mantle of the ugly!

source_text: And when your soul becometh great, then doth it become haughty, and in your sublimity there is wickedness.
target_text: And when your soul becometh great, then doth it become haughty, and in your sublimity there is wickedness.

source_text: But they misunderstand one another.
target_text: But they misunderstand one another.

source_text: I know you.
target_text: I know you.

source_text: Ye shall only have enemies to be hated, but not enemies to be despised.
target_text: Ye shall only have enemies to be hated, but not enemies to be despised.

source_text: Ye must be proud of your enemies;
target_text: Ye must be proud of your enemies;

source_text: then, the successes of your enemies are also your successes.
target_text: then, the successes of your enemies are also your successes.

source_text: Resistance - that is the distinction of the slave.
target_text: Resistance - that is the distinction of the slave.

source_text: Let your distinction be obedience.
target_text: Let your distinction be obedience.

source_text: Let your commanding itself be obeying!
target_text: Let your commanding itself be obeying!

source_text: And all that is dear unto you, ye shall first have it commanded unto you.
target_text: And all that is dear unto you, ye shall first have it commanded unto you.

source_text: and let your highest hope be the highest thought of life!
target_text: and let your highest hope be the highest thought of life!

source_text: Your highest thought, however, ye shall have it commanded unto you by me -
target_text: Your highest thought, however, ye shall have it commanded unto you by me -

source_text: and it is this: man is something that is to be surpassed.
target_text: and it is this: man is something that is to be surpassed.

source_text: So live your life of obedience and of war!
target_text: So live your life of obedience and of war!

source_text: What matter about long life!
target_text: What matter about long life!

source_text: What warrior wisheth to be spared!
target_text: What warrior wisheth to be spared!

source_text: I spare you not, I love you from my very heart, my brethren in war!
target_text: I spare you not, I love you from my very heart, my brethren in war!

source_text: Thus spake Zarathustra.
target_text: Thus spake Zarathustra.

source_text: Somewhere there are still peoples and herds, but not with us, my brethren:
target_text: Somewhere there are still peoples and herds, but not with us, my brethren:

source_text: here there are states.
target_text: here there are states.

source_text: Well!
target_text: Well!

source_text: Coldly lieth it also; and this lie creepeth from its mouth:
target_text: Coldly lieth it also; and this lie creepeth from its mouth:

source_text: It is a lie!
target_text: It is a lie!

source_text: thus they served life.
target_text: thus they served life.

source_text: Destroyers, are they who lay snares for many, and call it the state:
target_text: Destroyers, are they who lay snares for many, and call it the state:

source_text: they hang a sword and a hundred cravings over them.
target_text: they hang a sword and a hundred cravings over them.

source_text: Where there is still a people, there the state is not understood, but hated as the evil eye, and as sin against laws and customs.
target_text: Where there is still a people, there the state is not understood, but hated as the evil eye, and as sin against laws and customs.

source_text: This sign I give unto you:
target_text: This sign I give unto you:

source_text: every people speaketh its language of good and evil:
target_text: every people speaketh its language of good and evil:

source_text: this its neighbour understandeth not.
target_text: this its neighbour understandeth not.

source_text: Its language hath it devised for itself in laws and customs.
target_text: Its language hath it devised for itself in laws and customs.

source_text: But the state lieth in all languages of good and evil;
target_text: But the state lieth in all languages of good and evil;

source_text: and whatever it saith it lieth;
target_text: and whatever it saith it lieth;

source_text: and whatever it hath it hath stolen.
target_text: and whatever it hath it hath stolen.

source_text: False is everything in it; with stolen teeth it biteth, the biting one.
target_text: False is everything in it; with stolen teeth it biteth, the biting one.

source_text: False are even its bowels.
target_text: False are even its bowels.

source_text: Confusion of language of good and evil;
target_text: Confusion of language of good and evil;

source_text: this sign I give unto you as the sign of the state.
target_text: this sign I give unto you as the sign of the state.

source_text: Verily, the will to death, indicateth this sign!
target_text: Verily, the will to death, indicateth this sign!

source_text: Many too many are born: for the superfluous ones was the state devised!
target_text: Many too many are born: for the superfluous ones was the state devised!

source_text: See just how it enticeth them to it, the many-too-many!
target_text: See just how it enticeth them to it, the many-too-many!

source_text: On earth there is nothing greater than I:
target_text: On earth there is nothing greater than I:

source_text: it is I who am the regulating finger of God
target_text: it is I who am the regulating finger of God

source_text: thus roareth the monster.
target_text: thus roareth the monster.

source_text: And not only the long-eared and short-sighted fall upon their knees!
target_text: And not only the long-eared and short-sighted fall upon their knees!

source_text: it findeth out the rich hearts which willingly lavish themselves!
target_text: it findeth out the rich hearts which willingly lavish themselves!

source_text: Yea, it findeth you out too, ye conquerors of the old God!
target_text: Yea, it findeth you out too, ye conquerors of the old God!

source_text: Heroes and honourable ones, it would fain set up around it, the new idol!
target_text: Heroes and honourable ones, it would fain set up around it, the new idol!

source_text: the cold monster!
target_text: the cold monster!

source_text: Everything will it give YOU, if YE worship it, the new idol:
target_text: Everything will it give YOU, if YE worship it, the new idol:

source_text: thus it purchaseth the lustre of your virtue, and the glance of your proud eyes.
target_text: thus it purchaseth the lustre of your virtue, and the glance of your proud eyes.

source_text: It seeketh to allure by means of you, the many-too-many!
target_text: It seeketh to allure by means of you, the many-too-many!

source_text: The state, I call it, where all are poison-drinkers, the good and the bad:
target_text: The state, I call it, where all are poison-drinkers, the good and the bad:

source_text: the state, where all lose themselves, the good and the bad:
target_text: the state, where all lose themselves, the good and the bad:

source_text: the state, where the slow suicide of all -
target_text: the state, where the slow suicide of all -

source_text: Just see these superfluous ones!
target_text: Just see these superfluous ones!

source_text: They steal the works of the inventors and the treasures of the wise.
target_text: They steal the works of the inventors and the treasures of the wise.

source_text: Culture, they call their theft -
target_text: Culture, they call their theft -

source_text: and everything becometh sickness and trouble unto them!
target_text: and everything becometh sickness and trouble unto them!

source_text: Just see these superfluous ones!
target_text: Just see these superfluous ones!

source_text: Sick are they always; they vomit their bile and call it a newspaper.
target_text: Sick are they always; they vomit their bile and call it a newspaper.

source_text: They devour one another, and cannot even digest themselves.
target_text: They devour one another, and cannot even digest themselves.

source_text: Just see these superfluous ones!
target_text: Just see these superfluous ones!

source_text: Wealth they acquire and become poorer thereby.
target_text: Wealth they acquire and become poorer thereby.

source_text: Power they seek for, and above all, the lever of power, much money -
target_text: Power they seek for, and above all, the lever of power, much money -

source_text: these impotent ones!
target_text: these impotent ones!

source_text: See them clamber, these nimble apes!
target_text: See them clamber, these nimble apes!

source_text: They clamber over one another, and thus scuffle into the mud and the abyss.
target_text: They clamber over one another, and thus scuffle into the mud and the abyss.

source_text: as if happiness sat on the throne!
target_text: as if happiness sat on the throne!

source_text: Madmen they all seem to me, and clambering apes, and too eager.
target_text: Madmen they all seem to me, and clambering apes, and too eager.

source_text: Badly smelleth their idol to me, the cold monster:
target_text: Badly smelleth their idol to me, the cold monster:

source_text: badly they all smell to me, these idolaters.
target_text: badly they all smell to me, these idolaters.

source_text: Better break the windows and jump into the open air!
target_text: Better break the windows and jump into the open air!

source_text: Withdraw from the idolatry of the superfluous!
target_text: Withdraw from the idolatry of the superfluous!

source_text: Withdraw from the steam of these human sacrifices!
target_text: Withdraw from the steam of these human sacrifices!

source_text: Open still remaineth the earth for great souls.
target_text: Open still remaineth the earth for great souls.

source_text: Open still remaineth a free life for great souls.
target_text: Open still remaineth a free life for great souls.

source_text: Verily, he who possesseth little is so much the less possessed:
target_text: Verily, he who possesseth little is so much the less possessed:

source_text: blessed be moderate poverty!
target_text: blessed be moderate poverty!

source_text: there only commenceth the man who is not superfluous:
target_text: there only commenceth the man who is not superfluous:

source_text: There, where the state CEASETH - pray look thither, my brethren!
target_text: There, where the state CEASETH - pray look thither, my brethren!

source_text: Do ye not see it, the rainbow and the bridges of the Superman?
target_text: Do ye not see it, the rainbow and the bridges of the Superman?

source_text: Thus spake Zarathustra.
target_text: Thus spake Zarathustra.

source_text: Flee, my friend, into thy solitude!
target_text: Flee, my friend, into thy solitude!

source_text: I see thee deafened with the noise of the great men, and stung all over with the stings of the little ones.
target_text: I see thee deafened with the noise of the great men, and stung all over with the stings of the little ones.

source_text: Admirably do forest and rock know how to be silent with thee.
target_text: Admirably do forest and rock know how to be silent with thee.

source_text: Resemble again the tree which thou lovest, the broad-branched one -
target_text: Resemble again the tree which thou lovest, the broad-branched one -

source_text: Where solitude endeth, there beginneth the market-place;
target_text: Where solitude endeth, there beginneth the market-place;

source_text: In the world even the best things are worthless without those who represent them:
target_text: In the world even the best things are worthless without those who represent them:

source_text: those representers, the people call great men.
target_text: those representers, the people call great men.

source_text: Little do the people understand what is great -
target_text: Little do the people understand what is great -

source_text: that is to say, the creating agency.
target_text: that is to say, the creating agency.

source_text: But they have a taste for all representers and actors of great things.
target_text: But they have a taste for all representers and actors of great things.

source_text: Around the devisers of new values revolveth the world: -
target_text: Around the devisers of new values revolveth the world: -

source_text: invisibly it revolveth.
target_text: invisibly it revolveth.

source_text: such is the course of things.
target_text: such is the course of things.

source_text: Spirit, hath the actor, but little conscience of the spirit.
target_text: Spirit, hath the actor, but little conscience of the spirit.

source_text: in HIMSELF!
target_text: in HIMSELF!

source_text: Sharp perceptions hath he, like the people, and changeable humours.
target_text: Sharp perceptions hath he, like the people, and changeable humours.

source_text: To upset - that meaneth with him to prove.
target_text: To upset - that meaneth with him to prove.

source_text: To drive mad - that meaneth with him to convince.
target_text: To drive mad - that meaneth with him to convince.

source_text: And blood is counted by him as the best of all arguments.
target_text: And blood is counted by him as the best of all arguments.

source_text: A truth which only glideth into fine ears, he calleth falsehood and trumpery.
target_text: A truth which only glideth into fine ears, he calleth falsehood and trumpery.

source_text: Verily, he believeth only in Gods that make a great noise in the world!
target_text: Verily, he believeth only in Gods that make a great noise in the world!

source_text: Full of clattering buffoons is the market-place, -
target_text: Full of clattering buffoons is the market-place, -

source_text: and the people glory in their great men!
target_text: and the people glory in their great men!

source_text: These are for them the masters of the hour.
target_text: These are for them the masters of the hour.

source_text: But the hour presseth them; so they press thee.
target_text: But the hour presseth them; so they press thee.

source_text: And also from thee they want Yea or Nay.
target_text: And also from thee they want Yea or Nay.

source_text: On account of those absolute and impatient ones, be not jealous, thou lover of truth!
target_text: On account of those absolute and impatient ones, be not jealous, thou lover of truth!

source_text: Never yet did truth cling to the arm of an absolute one.
target_text: Never yet did truth cling to the arm of an absolute one.

source_text: On account of those abrupt ones, return into thy security:
target_text: On account of those abrupt ones, return into thy security:

source_text: Slow is the experience of all deep fountains:
target_text: Slow is the experience of all deep fountains:

source_text: long have they to wait until they know WHAT hath fallen into their depths.
target_text: long have they to wait until they know WHAT hath fallen into their depths.

source_text: Away from the market-place and from fame taketh place all that is great:
target_text: Away from the market-place and from fame taketh place all that is great:

source_text: away from the market-Place and from fame have ever dwelt the devisers of new values.
target_text: away from the market-Place and from fame have ever dwelt the devisers of new values.

source_text: I see thee stung all over by the poisonous flies.
target_text: I see thee stung all over by the poisonous flies.

source_text: Flee thither, where a rough, strong breeze bloweth!
target_text: Flee thither, where a rough, strong breeze bloweth!

source_text: Flee into thy solitude!
target_text: Flee into thy solitude!

source_text: Thou hast lived too closely to the small and the pitiable.
target_text: Thou hast lived too closely to the small and the pitiable.

source_text: Flee from their invisible vengeance!
target_text: Flee from their invisible vengeance!

source_text: Towards thee they have nothing but vengeance.
target_text: Towards thee they have nothing but vengeance.

source_text: Innumerable are they, and it is not thy lot to be a fly-flap.
target_text: Innumerable are they, and it is not thy lot to be a fly-flap.

source_text: Innumerable are the small and pitiable ones;
target_text: Innumerable are the small and pitiable ones;

source_text: and of many a proud structure, rain-drops and weeds have been the ruin.
target_text: and of many a proud structure, rain-drops and weeds have been the ruin.

source_text: Thou art not stone;
target_text: Thou art not stone;

source_text: but already hast thou become hollow by the numerous drops.
target_text: but already hast thou become hollow by the numerous drops.

source_text: and thy pride will not even upbraid.
target_text: and thy pride will not even upbraid.

source_text: Blood they would have from thee in all innocence;
target_text: Blood they would have from thee in all innocence;

source_text: blood their bloodless souls crave for -
target_text: blood their bloodless souls crave for -

source_text: and they sting, therefore, in all innocence.
target_text: and they sting, therefore, in all innocence.

source_text: and ere thou hadst recovered, the same poison-worm crawled over thy hand.
target_text: and ere thou hadst recovered, the same poison-worm crawled over thy hand.

source_text: Too proud art thou to kill these sweet-tooths.
target_text: Too proud art thou to kill these sweet-tooths.

source_text: But take care lest it be thy fate to suffer all their poisonous injustice!
target_text: But take care lest it be thy fate to suffer all their poisonous injustice!

source_text: obtrusiveness, is their praise.
target_text: obtrusiveness, is their praise.

source_text: They want to be close to thy skin and thy blood.
target_text: They want to be close to thy skin and thy blood.

source_text: They flatter thee, as one flattereth a God or devil;
target_text: They flatter thee, as one flattereth a God or devil;

source_text: they whimper before thee, as before a God or devil.
target_text: they whimper before thee, as before a God or devil.

source_text: What doth it come to!
target_text: What doth it come to!

source_text: Often, also, do they show themselves to thee as amiable ones.
target_text: Often, also, do they show themselves to thee as amiable ones.

source_text: But that hath ever been the prudence of the cowardly.
target_text: But that hath ever been the prudence of the cowardly.

source_text: the cowardly are wise!
target_text: the cowardly are wise!

source_text: They think much about thee with their circumscribed souls -
target_text: They think much about thee with their circumscribed souls -

source_text: thou art always suspected by them!
target_text: thou art always suspected by them!

source_text: Whatever is much thought about is at last thought suspicious.
target_text: Whatever is much thought about is at last thought suspicious.

source_text: They punish thee for all thy virtues.
target_text: They punish thee for all thy virtues.

source_text: They pardon thee in their inmost hearts only - for thine errors.
target_text: They pardon thee in their inmost hearts only - for thine errors.

source_text: Because thou art gentle and of upright character, thou sayest:
target_text: Because thou art gentle and of upright character, thou sayest:

source_text: Blameless are they for their small existence.
target_text: Blameless are they for their small existence.

source_text: But their circumscribed souls think:
target_text: But their circumscribed souls think:

source_text: Thy silent pride is always counter to their taste;
target_text: Thy silent pride is always counter to their taste;

source_text: they rejoice if once thou be humble enough to be frivolous.
target_text: they rejoice if once thou be humble enough to be frivolous.

source_text: Therefore be on your guard against the small ones!
target_text: Therefore be on your guard against the small ones!

source_text: Yea, my friend, the bad conscience art thou of thy neighbours;
target_text: Yea, my friend, the bad conscience art thou of thy neighbours;

source_text: for they are unworthy of thee.
target_text: for they are unworthy of thee.

source_text: Therefore they hate thee, and would fain suck thy blood.
target_text: Therefore they hate thee, and would fain suck thy blood.

source_text: Thy neighbours will always be poisonous flies;
target_text: Thy neighbours will always be poisonous flies;

source_text: what is great in thee -
target_text: what is great in thee -

source_text: that itself must make them more poisonous, and always more fly-like.
target_text: that itself must make them more poisonous, and always more fly-like.

source_text: Flee, my friend, into thy solitude -
target_text: Flee, my friend, into thy solitude -

source_text: and thither, where a rough strong breeze bloweth.
target_text: and thither, where a rough strong breeze bloweth.

source_text: It is not thy lot to be a fly-flap.
target_text: It is not thy lot to be a fly-flap.

source_text: Thus spake Zarathustra.
target_text: Thus spake Zarathustra.

source_text: It is bad to live in cities: there, there are too many of the lustful.
target_text: It is bad to live in cities: there, there are too many of the lustful.

source_text: Is it not better to fall into the hands of a murderer, than into the dreams of a lustful woman?
target_text: Is it not better to fall into the hands of a murderer, than into the dreams of a lustful woman?

source_text: they know nothing better on earth than to lie with a woman.
target_text: they know nothing better on earth than to lie with a woman.

source_text: Filth is at the bottom of their souls; and alas!
target_text: Filth is at the bottom of their souls; and alas!

source_text: if their filth hath still spirit in it!
target_text: if their filth hath still spirit in it!

source_text: Would that ye were perfect - at least as animals!
target_text: Would that ye were perfect - at least as animals!

source_text: But to animals belongeth innocence.
target_text: But to animals belongeth innocence.

source_text: Do I counsel you to slay your instincts?
target_text: Do I counsel you to slay your instincts?

source_text: I counsel you to innocence in your instincts.
target_text: I counsel you to innocence in your instincts.

source_text: Do I counsel you to chastity?
target_text: Do I counsel you to chastity?

source_text: These are continent, to be sure:
target_text: These are continent, to be sure:

source_text: Even into the heights of their virtue and into their cold spirit doth this creature follow them, with its discord.
target_text: Even into the heights of their virtue and into their cold spirit doth this creature follow them, with its discord.

source_text: Ye love tragedies and all that breaketh the heart?
target_text: Ye love tragedies and all that breaketh the heart?

source_text: But I am distrustful of your doggish lust.
target_text: But I am distrustful of your doggish lust.

source_text: And also this parable give I unto you:
target_text: And also this parable give I unto you:

source_text: Not a few who meant to cast out their devil, went thereby into the swine themselves.
target_text: Not a few who meant to cast out their devil, went thereby into the swine themselves.

source_text: To whom chastity is difficult, it is to be dissuaded:
target_text: To whom chastity is difficult, it is to be dissuaded:

source_text: lest it become the road to hell -
target_text: lest it become the road to hell -

source_text: to filth and lust of soul.
target_text: to filth and lust of soul.

source_text: Do I speak of filthy things?
target_text: Do I speak of filthy things?

source_text: That is not the worst thing for me to do.
target_text: That is not the worst thing for me to do.

source_text: Not when the truth is filthy, but when it is shallow, doth the discerning one go unwillingly into its waters.
target_text: Not when the truth is filthy, but when it is shallow, doth the discerning one go unwillingly into its waters.

source_text: Verily, there are chaste ones from their very nature;
target_text: Verily, there are chaste ones from their very nature;

source_text: they are gentler of heart, and laugh better and oftener than you.
target_text: they are gentler of heart, and laugh better and oftener than you.

source_text: They laugh also at chastity, and ask:
target_text: They laugh also at chastity, and ask:

source_text: What is chastity?
target_text: What is chastity?

source_text: But the folly came unto us, and not we unto it.
target_text: But the folly came unto us, and not we unto it.

source_text: let it stay as long as it will!
target_text: let it stay as long as it will!

source_text: Thus spake Zarathustra.
target_text: Thus spake Zarathustra.

source_text: "Always once one - that maketh two in the long run!"
target_text: "Always once one - that maketh two in the long run!"

source_text: I and me are always too earnestly in conversation:
target_text: I and me are always too earnestly in conversation:

source_text: how could it be endured, if there were not a friend?
target_text: how could it be endured, if there were not a friend?

source_text: The friend of the anchorite is always the third one:
target_text: The friend of the anchorite is always the third one:

source_text: the third one is the cork which preventeth the conversation of the two sinking into the depth.
target_text: the third one is the cork which preventeth the conversation of the two sinking into the depth.

source_text: Therefore, do they long so much for a friend, and for his elevation.
target_text: Therefore, do they long so much for a friend, and for his elevation.

source_text: Our faith in others betrayeth wherein we would fain have faith in ourselves.
target_text: Our faith in others betrayeth wherein we would fain have faith in ourselves.

source_text: Our longing for a friend is our betrayer.
target_text: Our longing for a friend is our betrayer.

source_text: And often with our love we want merely to overleap envy.
target_text: And often with our love we want merely to overleap envy.

source_text: And often we attack and make ourselves enemies, to conceal that we are vulnerable.
target_text: And often we attack and make ourselves enemies, to conceal that we are vulnerable.

source_text: thus speaketh the true reverence, which doth not venture to solicit friendship.
target_text: thus speaketh the true reverence, which doth not venture to solicit friendship.

source_text: If one would have a friend, then must one also be willing to wage war for him:
target_text: If one would have a friend, then must one also be willing to wage war for him:

source_text: and in order to wage war, one must be CAPABLE of being an enemy.
target_text: and in order to wage war, one must be CAPABLE of being an enemy.

source_text: In one's friend one shall have one's best enemy.
target_text: In one's friend one shall have one's best enemy.

source_text: Thou shalt be closest unto him with thy heart when thou withstandest him.
target_text: Thou shalt be closest unto him with thy heart when thou withstandest him.

source_text: Thou wouldst wear no raiment before thy friend?
target_text: Thou wouldst wear no raiment before thy friend?

source_text: It is in honour of thy friend that thou showest thyself to him as thou art?

source_text: A plaything let woman be, pure and fine like the precious stone, illumined with the virtues of a world not yet come.
target_text: A plaything let woman be, pure and fine like the precious stone, illumined with the virtues of a world not yet come.

source_text: Let the beam of a star shine in your love!
target_text: Let the beam of a star shine in your love!

source_text: Let your hope say:
target_text: Let your hope say:

source_text: "May I bear the Superman!"
target_text: "May I bear the Superman!"

source_text: In your love let there be valour!
target_text: In your love let there be valour!

source_text: With your love shall ye assail him who inspireth you with fear!
target_text: With your love shall ye assail him who inspireth you with fear!

source_text: In your love be your honour!
target_text: In your love be your honour!

source_text: Little doth woman understand otherwise about honour.
target_text: Little doth woman understand otherwise about honour.

source_text: But let this be your honour:
target_text: But let this be your honour:

source_text: always to love more than ye are loved, and never be the second.
target_text: always to love more than ye are loved, and never be the second.

source_text: Let man fear woman when she loveth:
target_text: Let man fear woman when she loveth:

source_text: then maketh she every sacrifice, and everything else she regardeth as worthless.
target_text: then maketh she every sacrifice, and everything else she regardeth as worthless.

source_text: Let man fear woman when she hateth:
target_text: Let man fear woman when she hateth:

source_text: for man in his innermost soul is merely evil;
target_text: for man in his innermost soul is merely evil;

source_text: woman, however, is mean.
target_text: woman, however, is mean.

source_text: Whom hateth woman most?
target_text: Whom hateth woman most?

source_text: I hate thee most, because thou attractest, but art too weak to draw unto thee.
target_text: I hate thee most, because thou attractest, but art too weak to draw unto thee.

source_text: The happiness of man is,
target_text: The happiness of man is,

source_text: The happiness of woman is,
target_text: The happiness of woman is,

source_text: now hath the world become perfect!
target_text: now hath the world become perfect!

source_text: thus thinketh every woman when she obeyeth with all her love.
target_text: thus thinketh every woman when she obeyeth with all her love.

source_text: Surface, is woman's soul, a mobile, stormy film on shallow water.
target_text: Surface, is woman's soul, a mobile, stormy film on shallow water.

source_text: Man's soul, however, is deep, its current gusheth in subterranean caverns:
target_text: Man's soul, however, is deep, its current gusheth in subterranean caverns:

source_text: woman surmiseth its force, but comprehendeth it not.
target_text: woman surmiseth its force, but comprehendeth it not.

source_text: Then answered me the old woman:
target_text: Then answered me the old woman:

source_text: Many fine things hath Zarathustra said, especially for those who are young enough for them.
target_text: Many fine things hath Zarathustra said, especially for those who are young enough for them.

source_text: Zarathustra knoweth little about woman, and yet he is right about them!
target_text: Zarathustra knoweth little about woman, and yet he is right about them!

source_text: Doth this happen, because with women nothing is impossible?
target_text: Doth this happen, because with women nothing is impossible?

source_text: I am old enough for it!
target_text: I am old enough for it!

source_text: otherwise it will scream too loudly, the little truth.
target_text: otherwise it will scream too loudly, the little truth.

source_text: "Give me, woman, thy little truth!"
target_text: "Give me, woman, thy little truth!"

source_text: said I. And thus spake the old woman:
target_text: said I. And thus spake the old woman:

source_text: Thou goest to women?
target_text: Thou goest to women?

source_text: Do not forget thy whip!
target_text: Do not forget thy whip!

source_text: Thus spake Zarathustra.
target_text: Thus spake Zarathustra.

source_text: And there came an adder and bit him in the neck, so that Zarathustra screamed with pain.
target_text: And there came an adder and bit him in the neck, so that Zarathustra screamed with pain.

source_text: When he had taken his arm from his face he looked at the serpent;
target_text: When he had taken his arm from his face he looked at the serpent;

source_text: said Zarathustra,
target_text: said Zarathustra,

source_text: as yet hast thou not received my thanks!
target_text: as yet hast thou not received my thanks!

source_text: Thou hast awakened me in time; my journey is yet long.
target_text: Thou hast awakened me in time; my journey is yet long.

source_text: said the adder sadly;
target_text: said the adder sadly;

source_text: my poison is fatal.
target_text: my poison is fatal.

source_text: Zarathustra smiled.
target_text: Zarathustra smiled.

source_text: "When did ever a dragon die of a serpent's poison?"
target_text: "When did ever a dragon die of a serpent's poison?"

source_text: said he.
target_text: said he.

source_text: But take thy poison back!
target_text: But take thy poison back!

source_text: Thou art not rich enough to present it to me.
target_text: Thou art not rich enough to present it to me.

source_text: Then fell the adder again on his neck, and licked his wound.
target_text: Then fell the adder again on his neck, and licked his wound.

source_text: When Zarathustra once told this to his disciples they asked him:
target_text: When Zarathustra once told this to his disciples they asked him:

source_text: "And what, O Zarathustra, is the moral of thy story?"
target_text: "And what, O Zarathustra, is the moral of thy story?"

source_text: my story is immoral.
target_text: my story is immoral.

source_text: When, however, ye have an enemy, then return him not good for evil:
target_text: When, however, ye have an enemy, then return him not good for evil:

source_text: for that would abash him.
target_text: for that would abash him.

source_text: But prove that he hath done something good to you.
target_text: But prove that he hath done something good to you.

source_text: And rather be angry than abash any one!
target_text: And rather be angry than abash any one!

source_text: And when ye are cursed, it pleaseth me not that ye should then desire to bless.
target_text: And when ye are cursed, it pleaseth me not that ye should then desire to bless.

source_text: Rather curse a little also!
target_text: Rather curse a little also!

source_text: And should a great injustice befall you, then do quickly five small ones besides.
target_text: And should a great injustice befall you, then do quickly five small ones besides.

source_text: Hideous to behold is he on whom injustice presseth alone.
target_text: Hideous to behold is he on whom injustice presseth alone.

source_text: Did ye ever know this?
target_text: Did ye ever know this?

source_text: Shared injustice is half justice.
target_text: Shared injustice is half justice.

source_text: And he who can bear it, shall take the injustice upon himself!
target_text: And he who can bear it, shall take the injustice upon himself!

source_text: A small revenge is humaner than no revenge at all.
target_text: A small revenge is humaner than no revenge at all.

source_text: Only, one must be rich enough to do so.
target_text: Only, one must be rich enough to do so.

source_text: I do not like your cold justice;
target_text: I do not like your cold justice;

source_text: out of the eye of your judges there always glanceth the executioner and his cold steel.
target_text: out of the eye of your judges there always glanceth the executioner and his cold steel.

source_text: Tell me: where find we justice, which is love with seeing eyes?
target_text: Tell me: where find we justice, which is love with seeing eyes?

source_text: Devise me, then, the love which not only beareth all punishment, but also all guilt!
target_text: Devise me, then, the love which not only beareth all punishment, but also all guilt!

source_text: Devise me, then, the justice which acquitteth every one except the judge!
target_text: Devise me, then, the justice which acquitteth every one except the judge!

source_text: And would ye hear this likewise?
target_text: And would ye hear this likewise?

source_text: To him who seeketh to be just from the heart, even the lie becometh philanthropy.
target_text: To him who seeketh to be just from the heart, even the lie becometh philanthropy.

source_text: But how could I be just from the heart!
target_text: But how could I be just from the heart!

source_text: How can I give every one his own!
target_text: How can I give every one his own!

source_text: Let this be enough for me: I give unto every one mine own.
target_text: Let this be enough for me: I give unto every one mine own.

source_text: Finally, my brethren, guard against doing wrong to any anchorite.
target_text: Finally, my brethren, guard against doing wrong to any anchorite.

source_text: How could he requite!
target_text: How could he requite!

source_text: Like a deep well is an anchorite.
target_text: Like a deep well is an anchorite.

source_text: Easy is it to throw in a stone:
target_text: Easy is it to throw in a stone:

source_text: if it should sink to the bottom, however, tell me, who will bring it out again?
target_text: if it should sink to the bottom, however, tell me, who will bring it out again?

source_text: Guard against injuring the anchorite!
target_text: Guard against injuring the anchorite!

source_text: If ye have done so, however, well then, kill him also!
target_text: If ye have done so, however, well then, kill him also!

source_text: Thus spake Zarathustra.
target_text: Thus spake Zarathustra.

source_text: But I ask thee: Art thou a man ENTITLED to desire a child?
target_text: But I ask thee: Art thou a man ENTITLED to desire a child?

source_text: Thus do I ask thee.
target_text: Thus do I ask thee.

source_text: Or doth the animal speak in thy wish, and necessity?
target_text: Or doth the animal speak in thy wish, and necessity?

source_text: Or isolation?
target_text: Or isolation?

source_text: Or discord in thee?
target_text: Or discord in thee?

source_text: I would have thy victory and freedom long for a child.
target_text: I would have thy victory and freedom long for a child.

source_text: Living monuments shalt thou build to thy victory and emancipation.
target_text: Living monuments shalt thou build to thy victory and emancipation.

source_text: Beyond thyself shalt thou build.
target_text: Beyond thyself shalt thou build.

source_text: But first of all must thou be built thyself, rectangular in body and soul.
target_text: But first of all must thou be built thyself, rectangular in body and soul.

source_text: Not only onward shalt thou propagate thyself, but upward!
target_text: Not only onward shalt thou propagate thyself, but upward!

source_text: For that purpose may the garden of marriage help thee!
target_text: For that purpose may the garden of marriage help thee!

source_text: A higher body shalt thou create, a first movement, a spontaneously rolling wheel -
target_text: A higher body shalt thou create, a first movement, a spontaneously rolling wheel -

source_text: a creating one shalt thou create.
target_text: a creating one shalt thou create.

source_text: Marriage:
target_text: Marriage:

source_text: so call I the will of the twain to create the one that is more than those who created it.
target_text: so call I the will of the twain to create the one that is more than those who created it.

source_text: The reverence for one another, as those exercising such a will, call I marriage.
target_text: The reverence for one another, as those exercising such a will, call I marriage.

source_text: Let this be the significance and the truth of thy marriage.
target_text: Let this be the significance and the truth of thy marriage.

source_text: But that which the many-too-many call marriage, those superfluous ones -
target_text: But that which the many-too-many call marriage, those superfluous ones -

source_text: Ah, the poverty of soul in the twain!
target_text: Ah, the poverty of soul in the twain!

source_text: Marriage they call it all;
target_text: Marriage they call it all;

source_text: and they say their marriages are made in heaven.
target_text: and they say their marriages are made in heaven.

source_text: Well, I do not like it, that heaven of the superfluous!
target_text: Well, I do not like it, that heaven of the superfluous!

source_text: No, I do not like them, those animals tangled in the heavenly toils!
target_text: No, I do not like them, those animals tangled in the heavenly toils!

source_text: Far from me also be the God who limpeth thither to bless what he hath not matched!
target_text: Far from me also be the God who limpeth thither to bless what he hath not matched!

source_text: Laugh not at such marriages!
target_text: Laugh not at such marriages!

source_text: What child hath not had reason to weep over its parents?
target_text: What child hath not had reason to weep over its parents?

source_text: Worthy did this man seem, and ripe for the meaning of the earth:
target_text: Worthy did this man seem, and ripe for the meaning of the earth:

source_text: but when I saw his wife, the earth seemed to me a home for madcaps.
target_text: but when I saw his wife, the earth seemed to me a home for madcaps.

source_text: Yea, I would that the earth shook with convulsions when a saint and a goose mate with one another.
target_text: Yea, I would that the earth shook with convulsions when a saint and a goose mate with one another.

source_text: This one went forth in quest of truth as a hero, and at last got for himself a small decked-up lie:
target_text: This one went forth in quest of truth as a hero, and at last got for himself a small decked-up lie:

source_text: That one was reserved in intercourse and chose choicely.
target_text: That one was reserved in intercourse and chose choicely.

source_text: But one time he spoilt his company for all time:
target_text: But one time he spoilt his company for all time:

source_text: his marriage he calleth it.
target_text: his marriage he calleth it.

source_text: Another sought a handmaid with the virtues of an angel.
target_text: Another sought a handmaid with the virtues of an angel.

source_text: But all at once he became the handmaid of a woman, and now would he need also to become an angel.
target_text: But all at once he became the handmaid of a woman, and now would he need also to become an angel.

source_text: Many short follies - that is called love by you.
target_text: Many short follies - that is called love by you.

source_text: And your marriage putteth an end to many short follies, with one long stupidity.
target_text: And your marriage putteth an end to many short follies, with one long stupidity.

source_text: Your love to woman, and woman's love to man -
target_text: Your love to woman, and woman's love to man -

source_text: But generally two animals alight on one another.
target_text: But generally two animals alight on one another.

source_text: But even your best love is only an enraptured simile and a painful ardour.
target_text: But even your best love is only an enraptured simile and a painful ardour.

source_text: It is a torch to light you to loftier paths.
target_text: It is a torch to light you to loftier paths.

source_text: Beyond yourselves shall ye love some day!
target_text: Beyond yourselves shall ye love some day!

source_text: Then LEARN first of all to love.
target_text: Then LEARN first of all to love.

source_text: Bitterness is in the cup even of the best love:
target_text: Bitterness is in the cup even of the best love:

source_text: thus doth it cause thirst in thee, the creating one!
target_text: thus doth it cause thirst in thee, the creating one!

source_text: Thirst in the creating one, arrow and longing for the Superman:
target_text: Thirst in the creating one, arrow and longing for the Superman:

source_text: tell me, my brother, is this thy will to marriage?
target_text: tell me, my brother, is this thy will to marriage?

source_text: Thus spake Zarathustra.
target_text: Thus spake Zarathustra.

source_text: Many die too late, and some die too early.
target_text: Many die too late, and some die too early.

source_text: Yet strange soundeth the precept:
target_text: Yet strange soundeth the precept:

source_text: Die at the right time!
target_text: Die at the right time!

source_text: Die at the right time: so teacheth Zarathustra.
target_text: Die at the right time: so teacheth Zarathustra.

source_text: To be sure, he who never liveth at the right time, how could he ever die at the right time?
target_text: To be sure, he who never liveth at the right time, how could he ever die at the right time?

source_text: Would that he might never be born!
target_text: Would that he might never be born!

source_text: Thus do I advise the superfluous ones.
target_text: Thus do I advise the superfluous ones.

source_text: Every one regardeth dying as a great matter:
target_text: Every one regardeth dying as a great matter:

source_text: but as yet death is not a festival.
target_text: but as yet death is not a festival.

source_text: Not yet have people learned to inaugurate the finest festivals.
target_text: Not yet have people learned to inaugurate the finest festivals.

source_text: The consummating death I show unto you, which becometh a stimulus and promise to the living.
target_text: The consummating death I show unto you, which becometh a stimulus and promise to the living.

source_text: His death, dieth the consummating one triumphantly, surrounded by hoping and promising ones.
target_text: His death, dieth the consummating one triumphantly, surrounded by hoping and promising ones.

source_text: Thus should one learn to die;
target_text: Thus should one learn to die;

source_text: and there should be no festival at which such a dying one doth not consecrate the oaths of the living!
target_text: and there should be no festival at which such a dying one doth not consecrate the oaths of the living!

source_text: Thus to die is best;
target_text: Thus to die is best;

source_text: the next best, however, is to die in battle, and sacrifice a great soul.
target_text: the next best, however, is to die in battle, and sacrifice a great soul.

source_text: and yet cometh as master.
target_text: and yet cometh as master.

source_text: My death, praise I unto you, the voluntary death, which cometh unto me because I want it.
target_text: My death, praise I unto you, the voluntary death, which cometh unto me because I want it.

source_text: And when shall I want it?
target_text: And when shall I want it?

source_text: Verily, not the rope-makers will I resemble:
target_text: Verily, not the rope-makers will I resemble:

source_text: they lengthen out their cord, and thereby go ever backward.
target_text: they lengthen out their cord, and thereby go ever backward.

source_text: Many a one, also, waxeth too old for his truths and triumphs;
target_text: Many a one, also, waxeth too old for his truths and triumphs;

source_text: a toothless mouth hath no longer the right to every truth.
target_text: a toothless mouth hath no longer the right to every truth.

source_text: going at the right time.
target_text: going at the right time.

source_text: One must discontinue being feasted upon when one tasteth best:
target_text: One must discontinue being feasted upon when one tasteth best:

source_text: that is known by those who want to be long loved.
target_text: that is known by those who want to be long loved.

source_text: and at the same time they become ripe, yellow, and shrivelled.
target_text: and at the same time they become ripe, yellow, and shrivelled.

source_text: In some ageth the heart first, and in others the spirit.
target_text: In some ageth the heart first, and in others the spirit.

source_text: And some are hoary in youth, but the late young keep long young.
target_text: And some are hoary in youth, but the late young keep long young.

source_text: Then let them see to it that their dying is all the more a success.
target_text: Then let them see to it that their dying is all the more a success.

source_text: Many never become sweet; they rot even in the summer.
target_text: Many never become sweet; they rot even in the summer.

source_text: It is cowardice that holdeth them fast to their branches.
target_text: It is cowardice that holdeth them fast to their branches.

source_text: Far too many live, and far too long hang they on their branches.
target_text: Far too many live, and far too long hang they on their branches.

source_text: Would that a storm came and shook all this rottenness and worm-eatenness from the tree!
target_text: Would that a storm came and shook all this rottenness and worm-eatenness from the tree!

source_text: Would that there came preachers of SPEEDY death!
target_text: Would that there came preachers of SPEEDY death!

source_text: Those would be the appropriate storms and agitators of the trees of life!
target_text: Those would be the appropriate storms and agitators of the trees of life!

source_text: But I hear only slow death preached, and patience with all that is earthly.
target_text: But I hear only slow death preached, and patience with all that is earthly.

source_text: ye preach patience with what is earthly?
target_text: ye preach patience with what is earthly?

source_text: As yet had he known only tears, and the melancholy of the Hebrews, together with the hatred of the good and just -
target_text: As yet had he known only tears, and the melancholy of the Hebrews, together with the hatred of the good and just -

source_text: the Hebrew Jesus: then was he seized with the longing for death.
target_text: the Hebrew Jesus: then was he seized with the longing for death.

source_text: Had he but remained in the wilderness, and far from the good and just!
target_text: Had he but remained in the wilderness, and far from the good and just!

source_text: Then, perhaps, would he have learned to live, and love the earth -
target_text: Then, perhaps, would he have learned to live, and love the earth -

source_text: and laughter also!
target_text: and laughter also!

source_text: Believe it, my brethren!
target_text: Believe it, my brethren!

source_text: He died too early;
target_text: He died too early;

source_text: Noble enough was he to disavow!
target_text: Noble enough was he to disavow!

source_text: Immaturely loveth the youth, and immaturely also hateth he man and earth.
target_text: Immaturely loveth the youth, and immaturely also hateth he man and earth.

source_text: Confined and awkward are still his soul and the wings of his spirit.
target_text: Confined and awkward are still his soul and the wings of his spirit.

source_text: But in man there is more of the child than in the youth, and less of melancholy:
target_text: But in man there is more of the child than in the youth, and less of melancholy:

source_text: better understandeth he about life and death.
target_text: better understandeth he about life and death.

source_text: Free for death, and free in death;
target_text: Free for death, and free in death;

source_text: a holy Naysayer, when there is no longer time for Yea:
target_text: a holy Naysayer, when there is no longer time for Yea:

source_text: thus understandeth he about death and life.
target_text: thus understandeth he about death and life.

source_text: That your dying may not be a reproach to man and the earth, my friends:
target_text: That your dying may not be a reproach to man and the earth, my friends:

source_text: that do I solicit from the honey of your soul.
target_text: that do I solicit from the honey of your soul.

source_text: In your dying shall your spirit and your virtue still shine like an evening after-glow around the earth:
target_text: In your dying shall your spirit and your virtue still shine like an evening after-glow around the earth:

source_text: Thus will I die myself, that ye friends may love the earth more for my sake;
target_text: Thus will I die myself, that ye friends may love the earth more for my sake;

source_text: and earth will I again become, to have rest in her that bore me.
target_text: and earth will I again become, to have rest in her that bore me.

source_text: Verily, a goal had Zarathustra; he threw his ball.
target_text: Verily, a goal had Zarathustra; he threw his ball.

source_text: Best of all, do I see you, my friends, throw the golden ball!
target_text: Best of all, do I see you, my friends, throw the golden ball!

source_text: Thus spake Zarathustra.
target_text: Thus spake Zarathustra.

source_text: "The Pied Cow,"
target_text: "The Pied Cow,"

source_text: there followed him many people who called themselves his disciples, and kept him company.
target_text: there followed him many people who called themselves his disciples, and kept him company.

source_text: Then Zarathustra told them that he now wanted to go alone;
target_text: Then Zarathustra told them that he now wanted to go alone;

source_text: for he was fond of going alone.
target_text: for he was fond of going alone.

source_text: His disciples, however, presented him at his departure with a staff, on the golden handle of which a serpent twined round the sun.
target_text: His disciples, however, presented him at his departure with a staff, on the golden handle of which a serpent twined round the sun.

source_text: Zarathustra rejoiced on account of the staff, and supported himself thereon;
target_text: Zarathustra rejoiced on account of the staff, and supported himself thereon;

source_text: then spake he thus to his disciples:
target_text: then spake he thus to his disciples:

source_text: Tell me, pray:
target_text: Tell me, pray:

source_text: how came gold to the highest value?
target_text: how came gold to the highest value?

source_text: Because it is uncommon, and unprofiting, and beaming, and soft in lustre;
target_text: Because it is uncommon, and unprofiting, and beaming, and soft in lustre;

source_text: it always bestoweth itself.
target_text: it always bestoweth itself.

source_text: Only as image of the highest virtue came gold to the highest value.
target_text: Only as image of the highest virtue came gold to the highest value.

source_text: Gold-lustre maketh peace between moon and sun.
target_text: Gold-lustre maketh peace between moon and sun.

source_text: Uncommon is the highest virtue, and unprofiting, beaming is it, and soft of lustre:
target_text: Uncommon is the highest virtue, and unprofiting, beaming is it, and soft of lustre:

source_text: Verily, I divine you well, my disciples:
target_text: Verily, I divine you well, my disciples:

source_text: ye strive like me for the bestowing virtue.
target_text: ye strive like me for the bestowing virtue.

source_text: It is your thirst to become sacrifices and gifts yourselves:
target_text: It is your thirst to become sacrifices and gifts yourselves:

source_text: and therefore have ye the thirst to accumulate all riches in your soul.
target_text: and therefore have ye the thirst to accumulate all riches in your soul.

source_text: Verily, an appropriator of all values must such bestowing love become;
target_text: Verily, an appropriator of all values must such bestowing love become;

source_text: but healthy and holy, call I this selfishness.
target_text: but healthy and holy, call I this selfishness.

source_text: the selfishness of the sick, the sickly selfishness.
target_text: the selfishness of the sick, the sickly selfishness.

source_text: With the eye of the thief it looketh upon all that is lustrous;
target_text: With the eye of the thief it looketh upon all that is lustrous;

source_text: with the craving of hunger it measureth him who hath abundance;
target_text: with the craving of hunger it measureth him who hath abundance;

source_text: of a sickly body, speaketh the larcenous craving of this selfishness.
target_text: of a sickly body, speaketh the larcenous craving of this selfishness.

source_text: Tell me, my brother, what do we think bad, and worst of all?
target_text: Tell me, my brother, what do we think bad, and worst of all?

source_text: Is it not DEGENERATION?
target_text: Is it not DEGENERATION?

source_text: And we always suspect degeneration when the bestowing soul is lacking.
target_text: And we always suspect degeneration when the bestowing soul is lacking.

source_text: Upward goeth our course from genera on to super-genera.
target_text: Upward goeth our course from genera on to super-genera.

source_text: But a horror to us is the degenerating sense, which saith:
target_text: But a horror to us is the degenerating sense, which saith:

source_text: All for myself.
target_text: All for myself.

source_text: thus is it a simile of our body, a simile of an elevation.
target_text: thus is it a simile of our body, a simile of an elevation.

source_text: Such similes of elevations are the names of the virtues.
target_text: Such similes of elevations are the names of the virtues.

source_text: And the spirit - what is it to the body?
target_text: And the spirit - what is it to the body?

source_text: Similes, are all names of good and evil;
target_text: Similes, are all names of good and evil;

source_text: they do not speak out, they only hint.
target_text: they do not speak out, they only hint.

source_text: A fool who seeketh knowledge from them!
target_text: A fool who seeketh knowledge from them!

source_text: Give heed, my brethren, to every hour when your spirit would speak in similes:
target_text: Give heed, my brethren, to every hour when your spirit would speak in similes:

source_text: there is the origin of your virtue.
target_text: there is the origin of your virtue.

source_text: Elevated is then your body, and raised up;
target_text: Elevated is then your body, and raised up;

source_text: with its delight, enraptureth it the spirit;
target_text: with its delight, enraptureth it the spirit;

source_text: so that it becometh creator, and valuer, and lover, and everything's benefactor.
target_text: so that it becometh creator, and valuer, and lover, and everything's benefactor.

source_text: there is the origin of your virtue.
target_text: there is the origin of your virtue.

source_text: When ye are exalted above praise and blame, and your will would command all things, as a loving one's will:
target_text: When ye are exalted above praise and blame, and your will would command all things, as a loving one's will:

source_text: there is the origin of your virtue.
target_text: there is the origin of your virtue.

source_text: When ye despise pleasant things, and the effeminate couch, and cannot couch far enough from the effeminate:
target_text: When ye despise pleasant things, and the effeminate couch, and cannot couch far enough from the effeminate:

source_text: there is the origin of your virtue.
target_text: there is the origin of your virtue.

source_text: When ye are willers of one will, and when that change of every need is needful to you:
target_text: When ye are willers of one will, and when that change of every need is needful to you:

source_text: there is the origin of your virtue.
target_text: there is the origin of your virtue.

source_text: Verily, a new good and evil is it!
target_text: Verily, a new good and evil is it!

source_text: Verily, a new deep murmuring, and the voice of a new fountain!
target_text: Verily, a new deep murmuring, and the voice of a new fountain!

source_text: Power is it, this new virtue;
target_text: Power is it, this new virtue;

source_text: a ruling thought is it, and around it a subtle soul:
target_text: a ruling thought is it, and around it a subtle soul:

source_text: a golden sun, with the serpent of knowledge around it.
target_text: a golden sun, with the serpent of knowledge around it.

source_text: Then he continued to speak thus -
target_text: Then he continued to speak thus -

source_text: and his voice had changed:
target_text: and his voice had changed:

source_text: Remain true to the earth, my brethren, with the power of your virtue!
target_text: Remain true to the earth, my brethren, with the power of your virtue!

source_text: Let your bestowing love and your knowledge be devoted to be the meaning of the earth!
target_text: Let your bestowing love and your knowledge be devoted to be the meaning of the earth!

source_text: Thus do I pray and conjure you.
target_text: Thus do I pray and conjure you.

source_text: Let it not fly away from the earthly and beat against eternal walls with its wings!
target_text: Let it not fly away from the earthly and beat against eternal walls with its wings!

source_text: Ah, there hath always been so much flown-away virtue!
target_text: Ah, there hath always been so much flown-away virtue!

source_text: yea, back to body and life:
target_text: yea, back to body and life:

source_text: that it may give to the earth its meaning, a human meaning!
target_text: that it may give to the earth its meaning, a human meaning!

source_text: body and will hath it there become.
target_text: body and will hath it there become.

source_text: A hundred times hitherto hath spirit as well as virtue attempted and erred.
target_text: A hundred times hitherto hath spirit as well as virtue attempted and erred.

source_text: Yea, an attempt hath man been.
target_text: Yea, an attempt hath man been.

source_text: Alas, much ignorance and error hath become embodied in us!
target_text: Alas, much ignorance and error hath become embodied in us!

source_text: Not only the rationality of millenniums -
target_text: Not only the rationality of millenniums -

source_text: also their madness, breaketh out in us.
target_text: also their madness, breaketh out in us.

source_text: Let your spirit and your virtue be devoted to the sense of the earth, my brethren:
target_text: Let your spirit and your virtue be devoted to the sense of the earth, my brethren:

source_text: let the value of everything be determined anew by you!
target_text: let the value of everything be determined anew by you!

source_text: Therefore shall ye be fighters!
target_text: Therefore shall ye be fighters!

source_text: Therefore shall ye be creators!
target_text: Therefore shall ye be creators!

source_text: Intelligently doth the body purify itself;
target_text: Intelligently doth the body purify itself;

source_text: attempting with intelligence it exalteth itself;
target_text: attempting with intelligence it exalteth itself;

source_text: to the exalted the soul becometh joyful.
target_text: to the exalted the soul becometh joyful.

source_text: Physician, heal thyself: then wilt thou also heal thy patient.
target_text: Physician, heal thyself: then wilt thou also heal thy patient.

source_text: Let it be his best cure to see with his eyes him who maketh himself whole.
target_text: Let it be his best cure to see with his eyes him who maketh himself whole.

source_text: A thousand paths are there which have never yet been trodden;
target_text: A thousand paths are there which have never yet been trodden;

source_text: Unexhausted and undiscovered is still man and man's world.
target_text: Unexhausted and undiscovered is still man and man's world.

source_text: out of you who have chosen yourselves, shall a chosen people arise:
target_text: out of you who have chosen yourselves, shall a chosen people arise:

source_text: and out of it the Superman.
target_text: and out of it the Superman.

source_text: Verily, a place of healing shall the earth become!
target_text: Verily, a place of healing shall the earth become!

source_text: and a new hope!
target_text: and a new hope!

source_text: When Zarathustra had spoken these words, he paused, like one who had not said his last word;
target_text: When Zarathustra had spoken these words, he paused, like one who had not said his last word;

source_text: and long did he balance the staff doubtfully in his hand.
target_text: and long did he balance the staff doubtfully in his hand.

source_text: At last he spake thus -
target_text: At last he spake thus -

source_text: and his voice had changed: I now go alone, my disciples!
target_text: and his voice had changed: I now go alone, my disciples!

source_text: Ye also now go away, and alone!
target_text: Ye also now go away, and alone!

source_text: So will I have it.
target_text: So will I have it.

source_text: Verily, I advise you:
target_text: Verily, I advise you:

source_text: depart from me, and guard yourselves against Zarathustra!
target_text: depart from me, and guard yourselves against Zarathustra!

source_text: And better still: be ashamed of him!
target_text: And better still: be ashamed of him!

source_text: Perhaps he hath deceived you.
target_text: Perhaps he hath deceived you.

source_text: The man of knowledge must be able not only to love his enemies, but also to hate his friends.
target_text: The man of knowledge must be able not only to love his enemies, but also to hate his friends.

source_text: One requiteth a teacher badly if one remain merely a scholar.
target_text: One requiteth a teacher badly if one remain merely a scholar.

source_text: And why will ye not pluck at my wreath?
target_text: And why will ye not pluck at my wreath?

source_text: Ye venerate me; but what if your veneration should some day collapse?
target_text: Ye venerate me; but what if your veneration should some day collapse?

source_text: Ye say, ye believe in Zarathustra?
target_text: Ye say, ye believe in Zarathustra?

source_text: But of what account is Zarathustra!
target_text: But of what account is Zarathustra!

source_text: Ye are my believers: but of what account are all believers!
target_text: Ye are my believers: but of what account are all believers!

source_text: So do all believers; therefore all belief is of so little account.
target_text: So do all believers; therefore all belief is of so little account.

source_text: Now do I bid you lose me and find yourselves;
target_text: Now do I bid you lose me and find yourselves;

source_text: and only when ye have all denied me, will I return unto you.
target_text: and only when ye have all denied me, will I return unto you.

source_text: Verily, with other eyes, my brethren, shall I then seek my lost ones;
target_text: Verily, with other eyes, my brethren, shall I then seek my lost ones;

source_text: with another love shall I then love you.
target_text: with another love shall I then love you.

source_text: And it is the great noontide, when man is in the middle of his course between animal and Superman, and celebrateth his advance to the evening as his highest hope:
target_text: And it is the great noontide, when man is in the middle of his course between animal and Superman, and celebrateth his advance to the evening as his highest hope:

source_text: for it is the advance to a new morning.
target_text: for it is the advance to a new morning.

source_text: After this Zarathustra returned again into the mountains to the solitude of his cave, and withdrew himself from men, waiting like a sower who hath scattered his seed.
target_text: After this Zarathustra returned again into the mountains to the solitude of his cave, and withdrew himself from men, waiting like a sower who hath scattered his seed.

source_text: His soul, however, became impatient and full of longing for those whom he loved:
target_text: His soul, however, became impatient and full of longing for those whom he loved:

source_text: because he had still much to give them.
target_text: because he had still much to give them.

source_text: to close the open hand out of love, and keep modest as a giver.
target_text: to close the open hand out of love, and keep modest as a giver.

source_text: Thus passed with the lonesome one months and years;
target_text: Thus passed with the lonesome one months and years;

source_text: his wisdom meanwhile increased, and caused him pain by its abundance.
target_text: his wisdom meanwhile increased, and caused him pain by its abundance.

source_text: One morning, however, he awoke ere the rosy dawn, and having meditated long on his couch, at last spake thus to his heart:
target_text: One morning, however, he awoke ere the rosy dawn, and having meditated long on his couch, at last spake thus to his heart:

source_text: Why did I startle in my dream, so that I awoke?
target_text: Why did I startle in my dream, so that I awoke?

source_text: Did not a child come to me, carrying a mirror?
target_text: Did not a child come to me, carrying a mirror?

source_text: "look at thyself in the mirror!"
target_text: "look at thyself in the mirror!"

source_text: But when I looked into the mirror, I shrieked, and my heart throbbed:
target_text: But when I looked into the mirror, I shrieked, and my heart throbbed:

source_text: for not myself did I see therein, but a devil's grimace and derision.
target_text: for not myself did I see therein, but a devil's grimace and derision.

source_text: my DOCTRINE is in danger;
target_text: my DOCTRINE is in danger;

source_text: Mine enemies have grown powerful and have disfigured the likeness of my doctrine, so that my dearest ones have to blush for the gifts that I gave them.
target_text: Mine enemies have grown powerful and have disfigured the likeness of my doctrine, so that my dearest ones have to blush for the gifts that I gave them.

source_text: Lost are my friends; the hour hath come for me to seek my lost ones!
target_text: Lost are my friends; the hour hath come for me to seek my lost ones!

source_text: With these words Zarathustra started up, not however like a person in anguish seeking relief, but rather like a seer and a singer whom the spirit inspireth.
target_text: With these words Zarathustra started up, not however like a person in anguish seeking relief, but rather like a seer and a singer whom the spirit inspireth.

source_text: With amazement did his eagle and serpent gaze upon him:
target_text: With amazement did his eagle and serpent gaze upon him:

source_text: for a coming bliss overspread his countenance like the rosy dawn.
target_text: for a coming bliss overspread his countenance like the rosy dawn.

source_text: said Zarathustra.
target_text: said Zarathustra.

source_text: Am I not transformed?
target_text: Am I not transformed?

source_text: Hath not bliss come unto me like a whirlwind?
target_text: Hath not bliss come unto me like a whirlwind?

source_text: Foolish is my happiness, and foolish things will it speak:
target_text: Foolish is my happiness, and foolish things will it speak:

source_text: it is still too young -
target_text: it is still too young -

source_text: so have patience with it!
target_text: so have patience with it!

source_text: Wounded am I by my happiness:
target_text: Wounded am I by my happiness:

source_text: all sufferers shall be physicians unto me!
target_text: all sufferers shall be physicians unto me!

source_text: To my friends can I again go down, and also to mine enemies!
target_text: To my friends can I again go down, and also to mine enemies!

source_text: My impatient love overfloweth in streams, -
target_text: My impatient love overfloweth in streams, -

source_text: down towards sunrise and sunset.
target_text: down towards sunrise and sunset.

source_text: Out of silent mountains and storms of affliction, rusheth my soul into the valleys.
target_text: Out of silent mountains and storms of affliction, rusheth my soul into the valleys.

source_text: Too long have I longed and looked into the distance.
target_text: Too long have I longed and looked into the distance.

source_text: Too long hath solitude possessed me:
target_text: Too long hath solitude possessed me:

source_text: thus have I unlearned to keep silence.
target_text: thus have I unlearned to keep silence.

source_text: Utterance have I become altogether, and the brawling of a brook from high rocks:
target_text: Utterance have I become altogether, and the brawling of a brook from high rocks:

source_text: downward into the valleys will I hurl my speech.
